goal: Record the clean Linux runtime before package testing
command: import json, platform, sys, subprocess, pathlib; print(json.dumps({"os_release": pathlib.Path("/etc/os-release").read_text(), "architecture": platform.machine(), "platform": platform.platform(), "python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable, "pip": subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "--version"], text=True).strip(), "working_directory": str(pathlib.Path.cwd()), "work_entries": [p.name for p in pathlib.Path.cwd().iterdir()]}, indent=2))
expected_behavior: Linux Python and pip available; work directory empty
interpretation: Exit status only; scientific/acceptance interpretation belongs in the report.
